allowlist.allowed_finding_shape: module-only trace with no package or function symbols
required_evidence: Go AST scan of every repository .go file, including build-tagged and test files, reports no OpenPGP import
go list -deps -test reports no OpenPGP package for host default, testing/no_ui, development, development/testing/no_ui, iOS testing/no_ui, or iOS development/testing/no_ui profiles
govulncheck raw finding remains retained and contains no OpenPGP package or function trace
allowlist.justification: The repository uses golang.org/x/crypto/ssh for Agent and Hub SSH transport. No affected OpenPGP package is imported or reachable in the reviewed package profiles. The module-level scanner warning is preserved; this guard reduces accidental reachability and does not fix the unmaintained package.
allowlist.fix_availability: No fixed module version was listed in the reviewed advisory database snapshot dated 2026-10-21.
allowlist.residual_risk: The module remains present and its unmaintained OpenPGP packages remain in the downloaded module source.

frontend_residuals.actual_mitigation: Run PR-controlled frontend tooling on isolated hosted runners with contents:read, no persisted checkout credential, no release secrets, and a bounded job timeout. Lingui catalog and Vite patterns are repository configuration and are not supplied through the Beszel runtime API.
frontend_residuals.exposure_limit: A contributor can alter the checked-in Lingui configuration in a PR and cause a build-time denial of service. The Hub embeds generated assets and does not ship or execute the Node.js tooling or braces package at runtime.
frontend_residuals.fix_availability: GitHub Advisory API review on 2026-10-22 lists no first patched version.
